name: Pyromancer: Expediting Power adds 5% to Echo of Nozdormu's Aspect's Blessing cooldown reduction (#1390)
contract: Expediting Power 704814 is aura 107 on SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 with base points 4 (+5), tooltip: Echo of Nozdormu reduces the cooldown of Aspect's Blessing by an additional 5%. Echo of Nozdormu 802174 takes 5% off the remaining cooldown of every known spell (AscensionPyromancerAbilities.cpp) and had no term for the talent. Aspect's Blessing 802168 has RecoveryTime 60000. A control Pyromancer without the talent casts the same two spells at the same moment; its Aspect's Blessing loses 5% of the remaining time, the talented one 10%, so the talented cooldown is about 5% of the remaining time (at most 3000 ms) below the control's.
